name: reveal-the-hidden-level-1-draws-a-card
notes: Reveal the Hidden at level 1: its effect (stealth loss, and the [Level 1+] draw) used to never run.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Reveal the Hidden's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
